climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Balaton PDO whose rules allow still and semi-sparkling wine. Welschriesling covers 45% of its vineyards, with Pinot Gris and Chardonnay next, and the allowed grapes also include Furmint, Hárslevelű and Kéknyelű.
